name: slot-approval-by-second-user
description:
The whole multiplayer shape, end to end: user A lists the companies, asks for the contacts of one, is refused because A has no standing on it, a SECOND user (the company's owner) approves, and A then sees the results. This is the ordinary case — the requester is usually NOT the owner of the record they are asking about. The approval mints the slot grant, and the grant is what lets the re-dispatched call through, per-requester, without A ever gaining standing on the company itself.

Read the assertions together: the recorded decision is `denied` because that is the Check that FIRED THE APPROVAL, and the re-dispatch after approval is not re-Checked into the log. What proves A actually saw the data is the tool result — contacts present, isError false. Asserting only on the agent's words would prove nothing, since the scripted reply says `Jane Smith` either way.

args._reason: user asked for the company list
user asked who works at that company

reply.text: Jane Smith and John Doe work at Northwind Trading
